purpose: Separate fixed-checkpoint sensitivity to the current candidate V-difference residual from differences caused by joint training; provide evidence for the next CNN backbone hypothesis without modifying the original CNN.
authorization: User preapproved failed-loop error diagnosis, separate isolated validation, and continued CNN-backbone research. Original CNN must remain unchanged and must not be inferred again.

conditions.on: Unmodified current candidate function a*(v0-v1)I(prev)+b*(v1-v2)I(prev2). Reuse verified stored rows for the paired reference.
conditions.off: Return zero only for observed_difference_residual in the isolated candidate process; retain projected V, existing Q/K, shared trained parameters, attention, head, memory, and all input/loader behavior.

intervention_boundary: Operation adapter in a separate process; frozen scientific files, checkpoint tensor/metadata and parameter/buffer/context state unchanged. Never write zero into parameters or save an ablated checkpoint. Restore original function identity after scoped intervention.
native_entry: Local synthetic tests and independent review. Show on equals original, off changes only the V residual, one/two/three-observation boundaries, missing/withheld masks, target-excluded features, batch consistency, and all state unchanged.
Fresh 5090 ownership/GPU idle and exact Runtime, then native three-candidate synthetic qualification.
All three unmodified-on native Validation replays must match stored six metrics, exact targets and actual exit0 before off evaluations.
Evaluate off Train and Validation only, with maximum3 concurrent candidates. No interpolation factors besides exactly0 and1.
preservation: No originalCNN/external/loop1/loop2 model inference. No Test.
No training, optimizer, new checkpoint selection, source edits, Runtime/auth/driver changes, old artifact overwrite, failed attempt retry or deadline extension.
New exclusive attempt and full stdout/stderr, actual transport/worker/pipeline exit and owned PID/GPU absence proof; immutable archive/manifest verification.
analysis: Compare off-minus-on signed/absolute/squared error on identical targets. Keep frozen15history cells, TrainQ25/Q75, common-entity weights and all seed exceptions.
Recompute full six metrics and additive error closures; no outcome-driven cutoff search.
Report fixed-checkpoint branch sensitivity only. Off is neither an originalCNN baseline nor the effect of training a model without this branch. Q/K/head/memory joint training remains inherited.
next_training_rule: Select a single nonredundant CNN hypothesis only if diagnostic evidence supports it. Neither a large filter gain nor a weak subgroup mean alone justifies a new clipping/gate/long-filter experiment. If unclear, retain the uncertainty rather than claiming a cause.
